combo_label: Moving House × Herbs & Spices × Stonehenge & Standing Stones

entries.clue: Stubby stone club, its rounded end worked in circles to crush whole seeds
Solitary leaning block outside the circle, near which the solstice sun comes up
Hard silcrete boulder from West Woods near Marlborough, dressed into the outer ring
Of the last age of polished flint and farming, before metal arrived
Narrow leaf tasting of aniseed, whisked into a bearnaise sauce for steak
Paper granting you a flat for a fixed term, after which it reverts
Alleged straight track joining ancient sites, popularised by a 1925 book
Chalk-cut trench of the first enclosure, its main bank heaped inside it
Angular Norse letter; raiders cut dozens inside Maeshowe in the 1100s
Set including a spare, left on the worktop for whoever moves in next
Yellow powder ground from a boiled and dried rhizome; it stains fingers and cloth
Yellowing documents that once proved a house was yours, a role the register now fills
